en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, and abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, altogether from Safwan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Does either Al-Khul’a or Al-Mubaraat happen except by purity?’ So heasws said: ‘It does not happen except by purity (from menstruation)’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan and Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al- Jabbar all from Safwan from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajj aj who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if al-Mubarat (disavowing) or al-Khul‘ can take place without Hayd (menses)-free period. He (the Imam) said, ‘It cannot take place without Hayd (menses)- free period.’”
